graphql.filesNote: Files are sent with the GraphQL multipart request spec. Name the variable that holds each file, for example file, input.avatar or files.0; it is set to null in the operation and the file travels as its own part. Leave the type on File.
graphql.prettifyTitle: Reformat the query. Comments are removed.
graphql.notSent: Not sent while the method is {{method}}.
graphql.schemaDescription: Fetch it to browse this endpoint's types and fields. The introspection query uses this request's URL, headers and auth.
graphql.moreMatches_one: {{count}} more type matches. Narrow the search to see it.
graphql.moreMatches_other: {{count}} more types match. Narrow the search to see them.
graphql.schemaTooLarge: The schema is larger than the response size limit.
graphql.noJsonBody: The endpoint answered {{status}} without a JSON body.
graphql.noSchema: The endpoint answered {{status}} without a schema.
